marc:datafield.marc:subfield: UWMMM : UCOP WILCHA MEGHONJANG MAKHLUK MUZIUM

This film tells about the organization of the World Ghost Show. Honor and interest in historical facts have been forgotten by the majority of today's society so much that historical materials in a museum are less attractive to visitors. On this basis, the museum hosts an exhibition of ghosts in the world in an effort to attract people to come to the museum. The organization of this World Ghost Show is unknowingly designed by certain parties in the effort to bring Count Dracula ..
